record.one_liner: Salesforce's commerce platform (B2C Commerce) with headless Commerce API (SCAPI) for storefront and admin integrations.
record.auth_notes: SCAPI Admin and Shopper APIs use OAuth-style client credentials: an Account Manager API client for Admin APIs and a SLAS client for Shopper APIs, both issuing JWT bearer tokens.
record.access_notes: Own-instance access needs a B2C Commerce instance or on-demand sandbox credits. A shared demo sandbox exists for trying SCAPI, but it is not a developer's own credential path.
record.api_notes: Two API families (Admin and Shopper) plus SDKs and CLI. Breadth not graded; judgement based on the docs overview.
record.blocker_notes: Production API use needs a B2C Commerce instance or purchased sandbox credits. The official MCP shopper service is a pilot that requires contacting an account executive.

evidence.quote: Create an API client in Account Manager (guide), then POST to oauth2/access_token.
To access an on-demand sandbox, you must purchase sandbox credits, enable appropriate permissions and users, and configure a client API ID.
SCAPI consists of two API types, plus open-source SDKs and a developer tooling ecosystem.
The B2C Commerce MCP Service is a fully-hosted service for linking an AI agent to real-time B2C Commerce data access.
